svg.aria-label: The centre above, every business unit below, and what crosses between them. The centre sets and builds the standards and the control set, the paved road and its patterns, the register, calibration across units and the portfolio view. It decides T1 and T2 approvals, exceptions above T4 and new patterns for the road. Each business unit, such as Customer Support and Business Customer Support, delivers its systems end to end with its own owners, data and raters, runs its own gate and adds local requirements on top. It decides T3 and T4 approvals, and its business owner accepts the residual risk. Standards and the road go out, written once for every unit, and a unit adds to them but never loosens them. Evidence comes back from every gate run in every unit into the register, and the portfolio view is read from it.
